summary.plain: UA2's own, more cautiously worded sighting of the Z boson: eight electron-pair events whose combined mass matched the particle UA1 had just observed.
summary.technical: UA2 Collaboration, Phys. Lett. B 129 (1983) 130-140; eight Z0 -> e+e- candidate events giving a Z boson mass of 91.9 +/- 1.3 (stat) +/- 1.4 (syst) GeV/c^2. Titled 'Evidence for', a more cautious claim than UA1's 'Observation'.

title: Evidence for Z0 -> e+ e- at the CERN anti-p p Collider
why_it_matters: A second, independent sighting of the Z boson using UA2's calorimeter-based design, with a mass measurement (91.9 GeV/c^2) consistent with UA1's, reinforcing the electroweak theory's prediction.
